summary: Russia launched multi-vector Shahed drone strikes across northern, eastern, and southern Ukraine on 18 September 2026, targeting Kyiv, Brovary, Kharkiv, Poltava, Chernihiv, and Mykolaiv oblasts, while a ballistic missile (RM48U) struck Mykilska Slobidka in Kyiv. The US approved transfer of 10 Patriot missiles from Germany, and the EU allocated €3.3 billion for Ukrainian missiles and drones. Polish PM Tusk and Slovak PM Fico visited Ukraine to discuss sanctions and infrastructure damage.

sections.executive_summary: On 18 September 2026, Russia launched a multi-vector Shahed drone campaign targeting Kyiv, Brovary, Kharkiv, Poltava, Chernihiv, Sumy, and Mykolaiv oblasts, while a ballistic missile (RM48U) struck Mykilska Slobidka in Kyiv's Dniprovskyi district. Five people were injured in an attack on an electric train in Kharkiv region. The US approved transfer of 10 Patriot missiles from Germany ($29.6 million), and the EU allocated €3.3 billion for Ukrainian missiles and drones, signaling intensified Western military support amid sustained Russian strikes.

sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting sustained multi-vector drone and ballistic missile strikes across Ukraine, with Kyiv experiencing repeated Shahed attacks and confirmed ballistic missile impacts. The use of RM48U ballistic missiles against the capital represents an escalation in weaponry. Russia's uninterrupted drone supply pipeline (per Putin) enables continued pressure. The Polish PM warned that Russia may expand hybrid attacks using drones and missiles against NATO-supporting countries, while Russia faces potential decisive response if Poland is attacked. The combination of sustained strikes and hybrid threat expansion indicates an escalating operational tempo.
sections.regional_response: Western military support is accelerating: the US approved 10 Patriot missiles from Germany ($29.6 million), and the EU allocated €3.3 billion for Ukrainian missiles and drones. Rheinmetall is scaling air defense production to 400 systems annually by 2027. Polish PM Tusk and Slovak PM Fico visited Ukraine on 18 September to assess infrastructure damage and discuss sanctions pressure on Russia. Ukraine is also expediting identification of repatriated military bodies with over 600 million hryvnias budgeted for 2027. Nova Poshta implemented air raid-triggered closures nationwide, reflecting the pervasive operational disruption.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Shahed drone campaign on 18 September 2026 demonstrated simultaneous launches from at least five vectors (Chernihiv north, Chernihiv south, Sumy, Donetsk, Black Sea), suggesting coordinated multi-axis attack planning. Interceptor systems from two unnamed companies successfully destroyed drones at high speed, indicating improving Ukrainian air defense effectiveness. The confirmed RM48U ballistic missile strike on Kyiv's Dniprovskyi district signals Russia retains ballistic strike capability despite interceptor improvements. The Dnipropetrovsk region also saw a drowning incident involving a man fleeing conscription officers, indicating domestic pressure on mobilization efforts.
